test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A sum of money invested at a certain rate of compound interest per annum amounts to Rs. 96,800 in 2 years and to Rs. 1,06,480 in 3 years. Find the rate of compound interest per annum.
solution:
Given:

A sum of money invested at a certain rate of compound interest per annum amounts to Rs. 96,800 in 2 years and to Rs. 1,06,480 in 3 years. 

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

One year of simple interest on a certain sum of money is equal to the compound interest incurred on it for one year.

Calculation:

Rs. 96,800 that amounts to Rs. 1,06,480 in the 3rd year acts the principal amount for one-year simple interest.

Let the interest rate be R% per annum.

According to the concept,

96800 + (96800 × R × 1)/100 = 106480

⇒ (96800 × R × 1)/100 = 9680

⇒ R = (9680 × 100)/96800

⇒ R = 10

∴ The rate of compound interest is 10% per annum.
